title: A second domain: CRM, configuration only

steps.title: Publish the CRM ontology; register the app
The CRM system of record writes customers, contacts and a backdated job change by command
Account managers and a support agent are registered with different grants
Meeting notes and a support ticket are ingested; the account plan is published to one account

request.content: Meeting note, Globex: Dana Reyes confirmed the renewal is due 2026-12-15 and that she signs the budget. She is worried about the Atlas export timeouts.
Support ticket TCK-4411 from Globex: the Atlas export times out on datasets above 2 GB. Dana Reyes asked for a fix before the renewal.
Call note, Initech: Priya Shah says Initech is comparing Atlas with a competitor ahead of its own renewal.
Account plan: Globex will accept a two-year renewal with an 8% uplift if the Atlas export timeouts are fixed.
